card.title: Why the code changes every 30 seconds

body.claim: Time-based one-time codes use the current time as a source of uniqueness.
body.why: The authenticator and the server both compute the code and check that they match. The default time step is 30 seconds, so codes are only valid for a limited time. They rely on a shared secret known to both sides.

probes.question: What does a time-based one-time password use as its source of uniqueness?
True or false: the default time step for these codes is 30 seconds.
